parole.significato: state (a political division, e.g. a US state)
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Staat (“state, country”), from Middle Low German stāt, borrowed from Middle Dutch staet, borrowed from Latin stātus. Compare Russian штат (štat).

parole.significato: cue (a stick for games such as billards)
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Stecken. Doublet of щик (štik) and стик (stik).

parole.significato: stand, rack, clothes rack (a frame or support on which clothes, goods, tools, etc. are hung or displayed)
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Ständer (“stand, rack, support”).
